title: #258 Serious or Entertaining
prompt: Some films are serious and designed to arouse audience's thinking. Other films are designed primarily to entertain. Which type of movie will you choose?

promptSegments.text: Some films are serious and designed to arouse audience's thinking.
Other films are designed primarily to entertain.
Which type of movie will you choose?

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Serious films are good because they teach us important things about life and people.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Serious films encourage deep thought by presenting complex issues, such as the difficult choices faced during war, thereby teaching important lessons about human suffering and conflict.

faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the preference between serious and entertaining movies, highlighting the importance of both types for different purposes and audiences.
outline: Introduction: Present the two types of movies and state the preference.
Body 1: Explain the value of serious movies in provoking thought and providing depth.
Body 2: Discuss the role of entertaining movies in offering enjoyment and escapism.
Conclusion: Summarize the importance of both movie types and reaffirm the preference.
keyArguments: Serious movies offer intellectual stimulation and deeper engagement through thought-provoking narratives.
Entertaining movies provide enjoyment and a much-needed escape from daily life, appealing to a broader audience.
